def servo(q,steps=10,tag='servo',ramp=True,balance=True):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=[]);start=from_obs(o);actions=[];trace=[]
 for i in range(steps):
  if o.done:break
  cmd=start+(np.asarray(q)-start)*min(1,(i+1)/steps) if ramp else np.asarray(q).copy()
  p=dict(zip(spec['proprio_layout'],o.meta['proprio']['now']))
  if balance:
   pitch=np.arctan2(p['imu_gravity_x'],-p['imu_gravity_z']);roll=np.arctan2(p['imu_gravity_y'],-p['imu_gravity_z'])
   cmd[[2,7]]=-.45;cmd[[3,8]]=.65
   cmd[[4,9]]=np.clip(-.40+.9*(pitch-.03)+.20*p['imu_gyro_y'],-.85,.45)
   cmd[[1,6]]=np.clip(-.6*roll+.15*p['imu_gyro_x'],-.25,.25)
  a=norm(cmd);actions.append(a.tolist())
  with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'actions':[a.tolist()]})+'\n')
  o=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=['room_camera'] if i<steps-1 else None,video='none',note=tag)
  trace.append(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
 o.save(OUT/tag);o.save(OUT/'current');np.save(OUT/'target.npy',q);np.save(OUT/(tag+'_trace.npy'),trace)
 print({k:o.meta.get(k) for k in ['control_steps','done','reason']})
 print('IMU',np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])[-6:].round(3))
 return o
PY
